description: React component for editing incoming webhooks in Mattermost, including fetching, updating, and rendering the webhook editing UI.

classes.name: EditIncomingWebhook
classes.description: React component class for editing an incoming webhook, managing state, fetching webhook data, and handling updates.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state with serverError as an empty string.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches the incoming webhook data if webhooks are enabled.

methods.name: editIncomingHook
methods.description: Handles editing the webhook, sets the new hook, and submits the update.

methods.name: submitHook
methods.description: Submits the updated webhook, handles success by navigating back, or sets error message on failure.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders loading screen if hook data is missing, otherwise renders the webhook editing UI.
